rationales.insufficient: Not enough recent mandi arrivals or historical series are available for this commodity/state selection to generate a reliable sell/wait recommendation.
rationales.sellHigh: Current modal price (₹{{current}}/q) is tracking +{{diff}}% above the 10-year historical average (₹{{avg}}/q). Selling in current sessions locks in relatively strong rates.
rationales.stable: Current modal price is tracking in line with historical benchmarks. Selling decision should depend on immediate liquidity requirements, storage capacity, and local transport costs.

considerations.title: ⚖️ Practical Farmer Considerations Before Deciding
considerations.storageDesc: Holding produce incurs bag costs, fumigation, and weight shrinkage. For perishable crops like vegetables, immediate selling is almost always prudent.
considerations.transportDesc: Ensure the price spread between markets comfortably exceeds diesel and loading charges before traveling to a distant mandi.
considerations.liquidityDesc: If repayment deadlines or sowing input costs (fertilizer, diesel) are pressing, realizing current rates avoids borrowing costs.

disclaimer: This advice is provided purely for informational and decision-support purposes. Kissan Saathi does not guarantee future rates or profits. Actual prices received in APMC auctions depend on individual lot moisture, grading, arrival volume, and daily buyer participation.
